title: The Color Monster: A Story About Emotions
author: Anna Llenas

hero.name: Color Monster
hero.description: Round fuzzy monster character whose body colour changes to reflect different emotions — central to the book's concept
hero.source_note: Named character with distinctive design — source from Creative Fabrica, TPT, or Anna Llenas licensed clip art

ambiguous.issue: Could mean physically stirred/confused or emotionally jumbled
ambiguous.reason: In this book mixed up refers to emotions all tangled together — emotional confusion is the correct meaning

ambiguous.issue: Could map to a quiet scene or a person sitting still rather than the specific emotion of peacefulness
ambiguous.reason: Book uses calm as a named emotion represented by blue — the feeling of peace is the intended meaning

ambiguous.issue: Could map to a glass jar or the verb to jar/startle
ambiguous.reason: The monster sorts emotions into glass jars in the story — the noun container is the correct meaning

notes: The Color Monster is built entirely around named emotions (happy, sad, angry, scared, calm, love) so all six emotion words are high-priority fringe even though they are abstract — they ARE picturable as faces and are the core vocabulary of the book. The hero image must show the monster in a neutral or multicoloured state so students can point to it without it being anchored to a single emotion. If sourcing multiple hero variants (one per emotion colour) is feasible, that would extend the board's utility but is not required for the base board.

matching.note: Min 4 approved stems, no hard cap

cvc_decode.note: 3-5 groups x 3 CVC words (phonics, not theme icons)
